adapter_evidence.product_pages: https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/<family>/<product>/ (NXAIR, SIVACON S8, SIVACON 8PS, Cerberus …) carry marketing text and no specification table; ratings appear only in prose.
adapter_evidence.catalogs: The pages link official catalog and brochure PDFs on https://assets.new.siemens.com/siemens/assets/api/uuid:<id>/<name>.pdf (HA 25.73 NXAIR, SIVACON S8plus, SIVACON 8PS 'Energy and data successfully put on track'). Their technical-data pages start with a running header 'Technical data' plus the section.
adapter_evidence.robots: www.siemens.com disallows /*? and declares per-locale sitemaps (en-us 30 MB); assets.new.siemens.com disallows nothing.

known_gaps: Catalog tables are kept as layout rows: wrapped labels and values that span several rating columns are not re-columned; the reviewer names the column in map-field.
Fire detection (Cerberus) and the 8PS busway pages link no catalog with technical data except the 8PS brochure; Cerberus rows stay open.
Siemens leak detection is not a published product line on siemens.com/en-us.
Product profiles, environmental declarations and SIMARIS tool flyers are not followed.
